selection_policy: Choose the shortest complete thought that preserves the speaker's meaning and can stand without invented context.

candidates.title: What a trustworthy graph keeps together
candidates.hook: A link between two ideas is only as useful as its evidence.
candidates.cut_rationale: The opening names the problem, then gives a concrete three-part answer: claim, passage, and source fingerprint.

candidates.title: Inspectability, not certainty
candidates.hook: Provenance does not make every claim true.
candidates.cut_rationale: The conclusion is self-contained, gives the reader one action, and ends on the sharper promise: each claim becomes inspectable.
